checks.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk /opt/anaconda3/bin/python3 scripts/build_map_first.py --output-dir .build
rtk git status --short --branch
rtk git rev-parse HEAD
rtk find .build -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | sed -n '1,80p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4444/status; rtk curl -sS -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4444/session -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"capabilities\":{\"alwaysMatch\":{\"browserName\":\"safari\",\"platformName\":\"mac\"}}}'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'sw_vers; safaridriver --version; mdls -name kMDItemCFBundleIdentifier -name kMDItemCFBundleShortVersionString -name kMDItemVersion /Applications/Safari.app; defaults read /Applications/Safari.app/Contents/Info.plist CFBundleVersion; uname -a'

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git show 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:QA/gate5/candidate.json | jq '{status,candidate_head,source_binding,verify_required,workflow,gate4_reference}'; rtk git show 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:QA/gate5/finding_matrix.json | jq '{candidate_head,rows:[.rows[]|{finding,status,evidence:(if (.evidence|type)==\"object\" then {decision:.evidence.decision,status:.evidence.status,base_revision:.evidence.base_revision,candidate_revision:.evidence.candidate_revision} else .evidence end)}]}'"

/bin/zsh -lc "for f in QA/gate5/candidate.json QA/gate5/baseline.json QA/gate5/finding_matrix.json QA/gate5/paired_comparison.json QA/gate5/performance_summary.log QA/gate5/same_host_webkit_control.json; do printf '%s ' \""'$f"; rtk git rev-parse 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:$f; done'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git -C /private/tmp/chg65-r10.UmjT2d/r9 status --short --branch; rtk git -C /private/tmp/chg65-r10.UmjT2d/r9 rev-parse HEAD; rtk git -C /private/tmp/chg65-r10.UmjT2d/base status --short --branch; rtk git -C /private/tmp/chg65-r10.UmjT2d/base rev-parse HEAD; rtk git status --short --branch; rtk git rev-parse HEAD'
/bin/zsh -lc 'which idevice_id >/dev/null 2>&1 && idevice_id -l || true; which ios_webkit_debug_proxy >/dev/null 2>&1 && ios_webkit_debug_proxy --version || true'
/bin/zsh -lc "xcrun xctrace list devices 2>&1 | sed -n '1,160p'; xcrun devicectl list devices 2>&1 | sed -n '1,200p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git show 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:QA/map_first/location_gap_visuals.json | jq '{status,revision,candidate_head,failures,checks:(.checks // null),summary:(.summary // null),race:(.race // null)}'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git show 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:QA/gate5/same_host_webkit_control.json | jq '{status,decision,base_revision,candidate_revision,runtime:(.runtime // null),summary:(.summary // null),failures:(.failures // null),cases:([.cases[]? | {viewport,detector_status:([.states.overall.detector.status,.states.detail.detector.status] | unique),interpretation:([.states.overall.interpretation,.states.detail.interpretation] | unique)}])}'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git show 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:QA/gate5/paired_comparison.json | jq '{status,base_revision,candidate_revision,environment_match,verify_required,failures,metrics:(.metrics // null),decisive_regression:(.decisive_regression // null),summary:(.summary // null),performance:(.performance // null)}'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git show 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:QA/gate5/paired_comparison.json | jq '.. | objects | select(has(\"decisive_regression\") or has(\"stable_non_regression\") or has(\"status\")) | {metric:(.metric // null),status:(.status // null),decisive_regression:(.decisive_regression // null),stable_non_regression:(.stable_non_regression // null),rationale:(.rationale // null)}' | sed -n '1,180p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git show 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:QA/gate5/candidate.json | jq '.browser_matrix | {type:(type),keys:(if type==\"object\" then keys else [] end),length:(if type==\"array\" then length else null end)}'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git rev-parse 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:manifests/gate5_field_quality_contract.json; rtk git rev-parse 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:QA/map_first/full_acceptance.json; rtk git rev-parse 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:QA/map_first/location_gap_visuals.json; rtk git rev-parse 9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d:QA/map_first/cross_browser.json'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git status --short --branch; rtk rg --files QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10 | sort; rtk /opt/anaconda3/bin/python3 -m json.tool QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/safari_execution.json >/dev/null; rtk /opt/anaconda3/bin/python3 -m json.tool QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/r9_comparison.json >/dev/null; shasum -a 256 QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/verification.md QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/safari_execution.json QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/r9_comparison.json QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/commands_and_logs.txt'

/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git add QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/verification.md QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/safari_execution.json QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/r9_comparison.json QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/commands_and_logs.txt
rtk git diff --cached --check
rtk git diff --cached --name-status
rtk git diff --cached --stat'
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git commit -m "qa: record CHG-65 Safari verification boundary"'

/bin/zsh -lc 'changed=$(rtk git diff --name-only 75d1f127dd5ce332df54e205e9a3d152de7af176..HEAD); bad=$(printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$changed" | rtk rg -v '"'"'^QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/'"' || true); if [ -n \""'$bad" ]; then printf '"'UNAUTHORIZED\\n%s\\n' \""'$bad"; exit 1; fi; printf '"'AUTHORIZED_ONLY\\n%s\\n' \""'$changed"'
/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git status --short --branch; rtk git rev-parse HEAD; rtk git show -s --format='%H%n%P%n%s' HEAD"

/bin/zsh -lc "rtk git diff --name-status f9edf2021451cc3040407636c226897a4505a8b7..9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d | sed -n '1,160p'; bad="'$(rtk git diff --name-only f9edf2021451cc3040407636c226897a4505a8b7..9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d | rtk rg -v '"'"'^QA/|''^'"\\.github/|"'^MANIFEST_SHA256'"\\.json"'$'"' || true); if [ -n \""'$bad" ]; then printf '"'NON_EVIDENCE_R9_DELTA\\n%s\\n' \""'$bad"; exit 1; fi; printf '"'R9_DELTA_EVIDENCE_ONLY\\n'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'bad=$(rtk git diff --name-only 75d1f127dd5ce332df54e205e9a3d152de7af176..HEAD | rtk rg -v '"'"'^(Changes:)?$'"' | rtk rg -v '"'^QA/project_os_verify/gate5_r10/'"' || true); if [ -n \""'$bad" ]; then printf '"'UNAUTHORIZED\\n%s\\n' \""'$bad"; exit 1; fi; printf '"'AUTHORIZED_ONLY\\n'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'non_evidence=$(rtk git diff --name-only f9edf2021451cc3040407636c226897a4505a8b7..9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d | rtk rg -v '"'"'^(Changes:)?$'"' | rtk rg -v '"'^QA/'"' | rtk rg -v '"'^'"\\.github/' | rtk rg -v '"'^MANIFEST_SHA256'"\\.json"'$'"' || true); if [ -n \""'$non_evidence" ]; then printf '"'NON_EVIDENCE_R9_DELTA\\n%s\\n' \""'$non_evidence"; exit 1; fi; printf '"'R9_DELTA_EVIDENCE_ONLY\\n'; rtk git diff --name-only f9edf2021451cc3040407636c226897a4505a8b7..9545401f2dad58d932b5de7f19c8f121ac024d9d | rtk rg -v '"'^(Changes:)?$'"' | sed -n '1,12p'"
/bin/zsh -lc 'rtk git status --short --branch; rtk git rev-parse HEAD; rtk git rev-parse HEAD''^'
